messages:
liam: Ran into onboarding friction: README shows --token flag for the CLI and Node sample uses process.env.TOKEN, but our CLI and SDKs standardized on REDWOOD_API_KEY. New hires keep copy/pasting the wrong var and getting 401s.

zara: ack. which files are wrong?

liam: quick snippet from README: `redwood --token $TOKEN generate --model redwood-v1` and node sample `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN })`. Dockerfile in samples/todo still sets AUTH_TOKEN.

henry: we should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and show both patterns: env var + explicit constructor. also add PS example because Windows folks hit quoting/expansion issues.

zara: i'll put together a small PR: fix CLI flag to `--api-key` note, change all env vars to REDWOOD_API_KEY, update Dockerfile, and add PowerShell snippet. will also add a short "If you see 401" troubleshooting note.

docs-bot: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/520 - "README + samples: REDWOOD_API_KEY parity, PS examples, 401 troubleshooting"

liam: thanks! henry can you review the SDK snippet parity once PR is up?

henry: yep, i'll verify node/python constructor + env fallback and confirm default retry counts to include in the note.

zara: PR incoming in ~20m. small change but should cut a lot of onboarding support pings. :sparkles:
